verifiedFacts.claim: With tool_choice any or tool, the API prefills the assistant message to force tool use, so the model will not emit natural language before tool_use blocks even if asked.
tool_choice auto lets Claude decide whether to call tools (no guarantee of a call); docs suggest auto plus explicit instructions when text context is wanted.
tool_choice tool forces a specific tool; any requires some tool but not a particular one.
